verdict.rationale: TaxJar is an API-first SaaS, so publishing a machine-readable spec is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only human-readable reference docs and language client libraries, which do not count as a downloadable spec. A probe of the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404 on every candidate URL, and no evidence documents a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
